context_title:
POST /api/chat → creates background task, returns task_id immediately
GET /api/task/{id}/stream → SSE stream with 15s heartbeats
GET /api/task/{id}/poll → polling fallback if SSE drops
Agent runs in background thread with up to 500 iterations
Serverside session storage persists agent state between requests
The system prompt is configured to keep the agent working autonomously—it won't stop midtask, will write complete code, run and test everything, fix errors on its own, and install dependencies as needed. This setup handles long 200minute runs well, and the frontend's polling fallback ensures sessions stay connected even if the SSE stream drops.
